header.title: Allocation Recipients
header.subtitle: Browse the complete history of allocation recipients, cycle statistics, and allocation distributions across all finalized Performance Cycles.
header.scopeTooltip: This page summarizes finalized Performance Cycles from the round API. Pending cycles and unrelated allocation retrieval records are not included in these totals.

recipients.intro: When a Performance Cycle finalizes, the participant who made the Final Gesture retrieves the Signature Allocation — {percentage}% of the Cycle Reserve, 1,000 CST, and a unique Cosmic Signature NFT. Additional allocations flow through Chrono-Warrior, Stellar Selection, Anchor Distributions, Public Goods, and the Compounding Cycle Reserve.

reserveSplit.label: Cycle Reserve Split
reserveSplit.tooltip: Percentages show how a finalized cycle's ETH reserve is allocated across protocol tracks.

signature.label: Signature
signature.tooltip: The Signature Allocation is the main ETH allocation, retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture.

chrono.label: Chrono
chrono.tooltip: The Chrono-Warrior allocation goes to the participant whose gesture carried the cycle through the most time.

stellar.label: Stellar ETH
stellar.tooltip: ETH set aside for Stellar Selection recipients. Each gesture creates selection frequency for these participant allocations.

anchor.label: Anchor
anchor.tooltip: ETH distributed to wallets with Cosmic Signature NFTs anchored to the protocol. RandomWalk NFT anchors receive Anchored-NFT Stellar Selection eligibility instead, not ETH.

publicGoods.label: Public Goods
publicGoods.tooltip: ETH forwarded from the cycle to the selected Public Goods Beneficiary, currently Protocol Guild.

nextCycle.label: Next cycle
nextCycle.tooltip: The remaining Cycle Reserve compounds into the next Performance Cycle after the finalized allocations are made.

totalCycles.label: Total Cycles
totalCycles.tooltip: The total number of finalized Performance Cycles so far.

totalEth.label: Total ETH Distributed
totalEth.tooltip: The combined ETH distributed as Signature Allocations across all cycles.

totalGestures.label: Total Gestures
totalGestures.tooltip: The cumulative number of gestures made across all finalized cycles.

uniqueRecipients.label: Unique Recipients
uniqueRecipients.tooltip: The number of distinct wallet addresses that have retrieved a Signature Allocation.

invalid.title: Invalid Cycle Number
invalid.help: The cycle number must be a positive integer.

notFound.title: Allocation Data Not Found
notFound.help: No data available for Cycle #{cycle}. The cycle may not have finalized yet.

error.title: Couldn't load this cycle
error.message: Cycle #{cycle} data failed to load. Try again, or go back to the recipients list.

hero.amountTooltip: Total ETH retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture when the countdown reached zero.
hero.nftTooltip: View the recipient's Cosmic Signature NFT(s) in the gallery. V3 cycles award several sequential NFTs to the Signature Allocation recipient.

recipientSection.title: Cycle Recipients
recipientSection.tooltip: All allocation recipients for this cycle. The Signature Allocation goes to the participant who made the Final Gesture; special roles receive additional allocations.

signature.title: Signature Allocation
signature.tooltip: The participant who made the Final Gesture when the countdown reached zero. Retrieves the Signature Allocation in ETH, 1,000 CST, and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

chrono.title: Chrono-Warrior
chrono.tooltip: The participant who held the Endurance Champion position for the longest consecutive interval. Retrieves ETH, Recognition CST, and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

endurance.title: Endurance Champion
endurance.tooltip: The participant who held the most-recent-gesture position for the longest uninterrupted interval. Receives a Recognition CST imprint of 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

finalCst.title: Final CST Gesture
finalCst.tooltip: The participant who made the last CST gesture of the cycle. Receives a Recognition CST imprint of 1,000 CST and a Cosmic Signature NFT.

distribution.title: Allocation Distribution
distribution.tooltip: Visual breakdown of how the cycle's Cycle Reserve was distributed across allocation tracks.

signature.label: Signature Allocation
signature.tooltip: {amount} ETH retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture.

publicGoods.label: Public Goods
publicGoods.tooltip: {amount} ETH forwarded to the Public Goods Beneficiary (Protocol Guild).

anchor.label: Anchor Distribution
anchor.tooltip: {amount} ETH distributed in proportion to each wallet's number of anchored Cosmic Signature NFTs.

stellar.label: Stellar Selection
stellar.tooltip: {amount} ETH allocated to the Stellar Selection pool.

statistics.title: Cycle Statistics
statistics.tooltip: Key metrics summarizing this cycle's activity and allocation distribution.

signatureEth.label: Signature Allocation ETH
signatureEth.tooltip: The ETH portion of the Signature Allocation retrieved by the participant who made the Final Gesture of this cycle.

publicGoods.label: Public Goods
publicGoods.tooltip: The amount forwarded to the Public Goods Beneficiary (Protocol Guild) from this cycle.

anchor.label: Anchor Distribution
anchor.tooltip: Total ETH distributed to participants who anchored Cosmic Signature NFTs for this cycle.

stellar.label: Stellar Selection Pool
stellar.tooltip: Total ETH allocated to the Stellar Selection pool across the cycle.

gestures.label: Total Gestures
gestures.tooltip: The total number of gestures made during this cycle.

attachedNfts.label: Attached NFTs
attachedNfts.tooltip: Number of NFTs attached to gestures by participants during this cycle.

anchoredTokens.label: Anchored Tokens
anchoredTokens.tooltip: Number of NFT tokens anchored to the protocol for this cycle.

uniqueAnchorHolders.label: Unique Anchor-holders
uniqueAnchorHolders.tooltip: How many unique addresses had tokens anchored during this cycle.

totalContributed.label: Total Contributed
totalContributed.tooltip: Combined value of all ERC-20 token contributions attached to gestures during this cycle.

ledger.title: All Allocations for This Cycle
ledger.tooltip: Complete ledger of every allocation record for this cycle — Signature Allocation, Chrono-Warrior, Endurance Champion, Stellar Selection, Anchor Distributions, and related NFT/CST distributions.

empty.gestures: No gestures were made in this cycle.
empty.endurance: No Endurance Champion data available for this cycle.
empty.stellar: No Stellar Selection recipients for this cycle.
empty.anchoring: No Anchor Distributions distributed in this cycle.
empty.nfts: No NFTs were attached to gestures in this cycle.
empty.erc20: No ERC-20 tokens were attached to gestures in this cycle.

contributions.nftsTooltip: NFTs attached to gestures during this cycle, forwarded to the participant who made the Final Gesture.
contributions.erc20Tooltip: ERC-20 tokens attached to gestures by participants, forwarded to the Signature Allocation recipient.

invalid.subtitle: This page needs a valid cycle number in the URL.
invalid.guidance: Open <allocations>My Allocations</allocations> to review completed cycles.

pending.breakdown: Allocation breakdown (Signature Allocation distribution, other allocations, and attached tokens) is on the allocation details page for this cycle.
pending.review: You can also review everything under <allocations>My Allocations</allocations>.

result.title: Congratulations! Cycle {cycle} Signature Allocation received.
result.sectionDescription: Summary of the Signature Allocation components for this cycle.
result.attachedTokens: {count, plural, one {# attached NFT} other {# attached NFTs}} (ERC-721)

next.title: Next steps
next.description: Stellar Selection may produce separate allocations, while anchoring may produce separate Anchor Distributions.
next.body: There could also be additional allocations from Stellar Selection. To view your allocations, go to the <allocations>My Allocations</allocations> page. For Anchor Distributions, visit the <anchors>My Anchors</anchors> page.
